---
title: Data grid page
description: The business list screen — an app shell whose grid takes the remaining height so only the grid scrolls, under sticky multi-level headers and frozen columns, with a filter panel in a dialog.
---

import DataGridPageTemplateDemo from '../../../components/template-demos/DataGridPageTemplateDemo.astro';

The layout every operational screen ends up wanting: the chrome — title,
filter chips, toolbar, pager — **stays put**, and the grid takes whatever
height is left so **only the grid scrolls**, both axes, under sticky
multi-level headers and frozen columns. Filter input lives in a dialog,
because twenty conditions do not belong above the data they filter.

This is the [CRUD list page](/hypermedia-components/templates/crud/)'s
sibling: that one is about the *contracts* a list screen needs (paging,
bulk actions, dialog editing, undo), this one is about the *frame* they
sit in when the grid is the whole point of the screen.

## Live template

<DataGridPageTemplateDemo />

Scroll the grid: the toolbar and the header rows stay, the first two
columns stay, and the page itself never moves. Open **Filters…** and
scroll the panel: its body scrolls while Search stays reachable.

:::note[Layout, not round trips]
This preview is deliberately server-free — it demonstrates what scrolls
and what stays. The rows are static and the filter panel does not
submit. The [wiring map](#wiring-map) below names the contract each
region's endpoint would implement.
:::

## The layout rule

```css
/* hc-shell__main becomes the row that holds the page column */
.app-main {
  display: flex;
  min-block-size: 0;
  min-inline-size: 0;
}

/* The page column: fixed regions, then the grid taking the rest */
.page {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-block-size: 0;
  min-inline-size: 0;
  gap: var(--hc-space-3);
}

.page > .hc-datagrid {
  flex: 1;
  min-block-size: 0;
  min-inline-size: 0;

  --hc-datagrid-max-height: 100%;
}
```

**Both minimums are load-bearing, one per axis.** A flex item will not
shrink below its content, and a datagrid is oversized on both axes: its
table is `inline-size: max-content` and it has as many rows as the page
returned.

- Miss **`min-block-size: 0`** and the grid grows to fit every row, so
  the *page* scrolls vertically — the toolbar scrolls away and the
  header row unsticks.
- Miss **`min-inline-size: 0`** and the column grows to the table's
  width, so `hc-shell__main` becomes the **horizontal** scrollport:
  scrolling right drags the title and the toolbar along, which is
  precisely what the grid's own scrollport exists to prevent.

The second one is easy to miss because the page looks correct until the
table is wider than the screen.

`--hc-datagrid-max-height` defaults to `70vh`, which is right for a grid
that sits **in** a scrolling page. Set it to `100%` for a grid that
**is** the page.

`hc-shell` already does its half: `__main` is `overflow: auto` with
`min-block-size: 0`, so the frame never pushes the viewport.

### Below the shell's breakpoint

Under `60rem` `hc-shell` deliberately becomes an ordinary scrolling page
(`display: block`, `overflow: visible`) — a fixed-height app frame is
the wrong shape on a phone. The grid then has no definite parent height,
so `100%` caps nothing and it would render every row at full height.
Restore a viewport cap:

```css
@media (width <= 60rem) {
  .page > .hc-datagrid {
    --hc-datagrid-max-height: 70vh;
  }
}
```

## Page skeleton

Real-app-shaped URLs; render the first page of rows server-side so the
grid is full before any JavaScript runs.

```html
<body>
  <div class="hc-shell">
    <header class="hc-shell__header">
      <button class="hc-button" data-variant="ghost" type="button"
              data-hc-shell-toggle aria-label="Open navigation">≡</button>
      <strong>Order desk</strong>
    </header>

    <nav class="hc-shell__sidebar" aria-label="Primary">
      <a href="/orders" aria-current="page">Orders</a>
      <a href="/shipments">Shipments</a>
      <a href="/customers">Customers</a>
    </nav>

    <main class="hc-shell__main app-main">
      <div class="page">
        <!-- Title row: applied conditions as chips, filter panel trigger -->
        <div class="hc-cluster" style="justify-content: space-between;">
          <div class="hc-cluster">
            <h1>Orders</h1>
            <a class="hc-chip" href="/orders?f-ship-from=2026-08-01">Ship date: this month</a>
            <a class="hc-chip" href="/orders?f-carrier=road">Carrier: Road</a>
          </div>
          <button class="hc-button" data-variant="secondary" type="button"
                  onclick="document.getElementById('filters').showModal()">Filters…</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Toolbar: left actions, separator, grouped actions, then the
             pager pushed to the trailing edge by the spacer. -->
        <div class="hc-toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Order actions">
          <button class="hc-button" data-variant="ghost" type="button"
                  data-hx-get="/orders/rows" data-hx-target="#order-rows">Refresh</button>
          <a class="hc-button" data-variant="ghost" href="/orders.csv">Export</a>
          <hr role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical">
          <div class="hc-button-group" role="group" aria-label="Approval">
            <button class="hc-button" data-variant="ghost" type="submit"
                    form="order-selection" name="action" value="approve">Approve</button>
            <button class="hc-button" data-variant="ghost" type="submit"
                    form="order-selection" name="action" value="reject">Reject</button>
          </div>
          <span data-hc-spacer="true"></span>
          <span aria-live="polite">4,901–4,940 of 5,000</span>
          <nav class="hc-pagination" aria-label="Pages">
            <a class="hc-pagination__item" data-hc-rel="prev" href="/orders?page=122">Previous</a>
            <a class="hc-pagination__item" data-hc-rel="next" href="/orders?page=124">Next</a>
          </nav>
        </div>

        <!-- The grid takes the rest. One form so checked ids serialize. -->
        <form id="order-selection" method="post" action="/orders/bulk">
          <div class="hc-datagrid" id="orders" data-hc-zebra data-hc-datagrid-pending>
            <div class="hc-datagrid__scroll">
              <table class="hc-datagrid__table">
                <thead class="hc-datagrid__head">
                  <tr>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" data-frozen rowspan="2" scope="col"
                        style="--hc-datagrid-left: 0;">
                      <!-- Select-all: no name — it must never serialize. -->
                      <input type="checkbox" class="hc-checkbox" aria-label="Select all">
                    </th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" data-frozen data-frozen-edge rowspan="2"
                        scope="col" style="--hc-datagrid-left: 2.5rem;">Order</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" colspan="3">Order</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" colspan="4">Shipment</th>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col">Ordered on</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col">Customer</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col">Item</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col">Ship date</th>
                    <!-- A long label reads down a narrow column instead of
                         widening it. `sideways` rotates the whole line. -->
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col"
                        data-orientation="vertical">Carrier service level</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col" data-numeric>Quantity</th>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__headcell" scope="col" data-numeric>Amount</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="hc-datagrid__body" id="order-rows">
                  <tr class="hc-datagrid__row" id="row-4901">
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell" data-frozen style="--hc-datagrid-left: 0;">
                      <input type="checkbox" class="hc-checkbox" name="ids" value="4901"
                             aria-label="Select order SO-4901">
                    </td>
                    <th class="hc-datagrid__cell" data-frozen data-frozen-edge scope="row"
                        style="--hc-datagrid-left: 2.5rem;">SO-4901</th>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell">2026-07-14</td>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell">Northwind</td>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell">Bearing assembly 1000</td>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell" data-editable data-col="ship"
                        data-value="2026-08-14">2026-08-14</td>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell">Road</td>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell" data-numeric>18</td>
                    <td class="hc-datagrid__cell" data-numeric>2,610</td>
                  </tr>
                  <!-- …the rest of the page's rows… -->
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- Filter panel. One form around header + body + footer, so Search
       submits the fields and the BODY is what scrolls. -->
  <dialog class="hc-dialog" id="filters" aria-labelledby="filters-title"
          style="--hc-dialog-max-width: 52rem;">
    <form method="get" action="/orders">
      <div class="hc-dialog__header">
        <h2 class="hc-dialog__title" id="filters-title">Filters</h2>
      </div>

      <div class="hc-dialog__body">
        <div class="hc-grid" style="--hc-grid-min: 18rem;">
          <div class="hc-field">
            <label class="hc-field__label" for="f-order">Order number</label>
            <!-- Value + operator share one bordered surface and one ring. -->
            <div class="hc-input-group">
              <input class="hc-input" type="text" id="f-order" name="f-order">
              <select class="hc-select" name="op-order" aria-label="Order number operator">
                <option value="eq">equals</option>
                <option value="contains">contains</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <!-- …the remaining conditions… -->

          <div class="hc-field">
            <span class="hc-field__label" id="ship-label">Ship date</span>
            <div class="hc-cluster" role="group" aria-labelledby="ship-label">
              <input class="hc-input" type="date" name="f-ship-from" aria-label="Ship date from">
              <span aria-hidden="true">–</span>
              <input class="hc-input" type="date" name="f-ship-to" aria-label="Ship date to">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="hc-dialog__footer">
        <button class="hc-button" type="button"
                onclick="this.closest('dialog').close()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="hc-button" data-variant="primary" type="submit">Search</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </dialog>
</body>
```

```css
.page {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-block-size: 0;
  min-inline-size: 0;
  gap: var(--hc-space-3);
}

.page > form,
.page > form > .hc-datagrid {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-block-size: 0;
  min-inline-size: 0;
}

.page > form > .hc-datagrid {
  --hc-datagrid-max-height: 100%;
}

@media (width <= 60rem) {
  .page > form > .hc-datagrid {
    --hc-datagrid-max-height: 70vh;
  }
}
```

The chain matters: every element between the page column and the grid
needs `flex: 1` and **both** minimums, including the selection `<form>`.
Break the chain anywhere and that axis scrolls the page instead of the
grid.

## The condition bar is the read-out

The strip under the title is not decoration: it is what the screen is
currently filtered by, and each chip is the way to change that
condition. One of them is **relative** — `start of this week
(2026-08-10)` — showing the expression that was stored *and* the date it
resolved to today, so the condition is never a guess and a saved view
built on it is still right next week.

Three consequences the template shows:

- **Export carries the query.** The button says *Export 5,000 rows* and
  its href holds the same conditions and columns — a download means
  this question, not the rows on screen.
- **Sort rides in the form** (`<input data-hc-datagrid-sort>`), so it
  survives an Apply and a saved view captures it.
- **A tweaked view says so.** The panel header shows **Modified** with
  Update / Save as new / Reset, because applying a view and changing one
  condition is the commonest thing users do with saved views.

## Wiring map

| Region | Component | Server contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| App frame | [`hc-shell`](/hypermedia-components/components/shell/) | — |
| Applied conditions | [`hc-filterbar`](/hypermedia-components/components/filterbar/) | [datagrid-filter](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-filter/) — one chip per condition, each opening its own editor; remove links drop one param |
| Toolbar | [`hc-toolbar`](/hypermedia-components/components/toolbar/) + `installToolbar()` | — (one Tab stop, arrow keys within) |
| Selection actions | `installDatagridActions()` | [datagrid-bulk-actions](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-bulk-actions/), and [datagrid-bulk-errors](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-bulk-errors/) for failures at scale |
| Pager | [`hc-pagination`](/hypermedia-components/components/pagination/) | [datagrid-pager](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-pager/) |
| Grid | [`hc-datagrid`](/hypermedia-components/components/datagrid/) | [datagrid-filter](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-filter/) for `f-<col>` params |
| Inline edits | `data-editable` + editor `<template>` | [datagrid-edit-errors](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-edit-errors/) (422 + confirmable warnings), [datagrid-edit-conflict](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-edit-conflict/) (409) |
| Filter panel | [`hc-dialog`](/hypermedia-components/components/dialog/) + [`hc-grid`](/hypermedia-components/fundamentals/layout/) + [`hc-input-group`](/hypermedia-components/components/input-group/) | [datagrid-filter](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-filter/) |
| Saved conditions | the panel's `view` select | [saved-views](/hypermedia-components/recipes/saved-views/) — including the **modified** state and update in place |
| Multi-value entry | `<textarea data-hc-multi="lines">` | [datagrid-filter](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-filter/) — pasted lists become repeated params |
| Relative dates | condition values like `@week-start` | [datagrid-filter](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-filter/) — stored as the expression, resolved by the server |
| Export | a link carrying the current query | [datagrid-filter](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-filter/) — same conditions, same columns, all pages |
| Column set / widths | — | [datagrid-columns](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-columns/), [datagrid-prefs](/hypermedia-components/recipes/datagrid-prefs/) |

## Adapt it

- **Header levels.** Sticky offsets are measured for **three** levels
  (`--hc-datagrid-head-1-h`, `-2-h`). A fourth needs its own rule.
- **Long column labels.** `data-orientation="vertical"` rotates the
  label so it reads down a narrow column instead of widening it;
  `sideways` rotates the whole line the other way.
- **Column bands.** Tint a column with `data-highlight` on its cells,
  or colour a header band by overriding `--hc-datagrid-head-bg` on
  those header cells — the grid expects to be re-skinned.
- **Filter panel from the server.** Swap the inline `<dialog>` for the
  [remote-dialog](/hypermedia-components/recipes/remote-dialog/) recipe
  when the condition set is per-user or large enough to be worth
  fetching.
- **No-JS.** The panel is a plain `<form method="get">` and the pager is
  plain links, so the screen filters and pages without JavaScript. The
  grid renders; only inline editing and the roving toolbar need it.
- **Density.** `data-density="compact"` on the shell tightens the whole
  screen; check touch targets if your users are on tablets (see
  [themes and runtime axes](/hypermedia-components/tokens/themes/)).
